origin: Alliant Powder's online Reloader's Guide (alliantpowder.com/reloaders, pistol / revolver and rifle recipes; scripts/data/loaddata/alliant_web_extract.py)
descr: Burn rate Ba fitted to 12 maximum loads of the manufacturer's published load data (5 cartridges), velocity error 3.3 % rms. Not published and therefore only typical or chosen values: Qex (the type (single/double base) is not published, double-base assumed because it fits the velocities better), k, material density pc, bulk density pcd, and the form function (a0, z1, z2: the data hardly determine it). Check every load against the manufacturer's current load data. Alliant publishes the velocity of its maximum loads (every charge is to be reduced by 10 % for a start load) and no pressures; the test barrel is the one listed with each recipe. Fewer data or a poorer fit than most other records (see the quality Qlty): use with more caution.
